newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Sat1 signs merchandise marketing agency.
newsitem.headline: German Sat1 signs merchandise marketing agency.

text.p: German private television station Sat1 said on Tuesday it had signed up licensing agency BMC of Munich to market its booming merchandise sales.
BMC will take on marketing activities for Sat1 licensed products which are not advertised on-air, effective from June 1, the station said.

"The decisive factor for signing the contract with BMC was its innovative marketing... and the surprising success of the cooperation between Sat1 and BMC, especially by the products linked to the "Kommissar Rex" (crime series)," Sat1 said in a statement.
Sat1 said in March its gross merchandising sales had multiplied 15 times between 1994 and 1996 and predicted further growth for 1997.
